pages.title: The final safeguard
pages.text: “They say your life flashes before your eyes when you die.”$(br2)Ghost Instincts automatically save you from a fatal blow: they activate $(l:beginning/spirit_form)Spirit Form$(/l) and leave you with half a heart. They may trigger when you have one heart left or when a hit would otherwise kill you.

pages.title: The price of survival
pages.text: Triggering Ghost Instincts costs 3 hunger points. If you do not have enough hunger, they cannot save you.$(br2)Warning! If you turn off $(l:beginning/spirit_form)Spirit Form$(/l) after being saved and take damage again, you may die. Leaving a possessed creature with $(k:key.spirit_form.toggle_spirit) may also trigger $(l:abilities/vanishing)Vanishing$(/l) if Ghost Instincts are enabled.$(br2)Instincts grant you another moment. How you use it is up to you.
